NODE_ENV.description: Runtime mode. Any value other than production (including unset) disables the production-only protections listed in config.runtime.production.

CHERRYPICK_CONFIG_YML.description: Configuration file, relative to .config/ (default default.yml, or test.yml when NODE_ENV=test).

CHERRYPICK_CONFIG_VALIDATION.description: What to do with invalid configuration and environment variables (default warn).

CHERRYPICK_URL.description: Used as url when the configuration file does not set it.

PORT.description: Used as port when the configuration file does not set it.

DATABASE_DB.description: Used as db.db when the configuration file does not set it.

DATABASE_USER.description: Used as db.user when the configuration file does not set it.

DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: Used as db.pass when the configuration file does not set it.

CHERRYPICK_MIGRATION_CREATE_INDEX_CONCUR.description: Recreate indexes of large tables with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY during migrations. Only 1 enables it.

CP_ONLY_QUEUE.description: Run only the job queue, without the web server. Any non-empty value enables it, including 0 and false.

CP_ONLY_SERVER.description: Run only the web server, without the job queue. Any non-empty value enables it, including 0 and false.

CP_DISABLE_CLUSTERING.description: Do not fork worker processes. Always enabled when NODE_ENV=test. Any non-empty value enables it, including 0 and false.

CP_NO_DAEMONS.description: Kept for compatibility. Has no effect. Any non-empty value enables it, including 0 and false.

CP_NO_JOB_SCHEDULERS.description: Do not register the repeatable jobs when the queue process starts. Any non-empty value enables it, including 0 and false.

CP_VERBOSE.description: Output debug logs even when NODE_ENV=production. Any non-empty value enables it, including 0 and false.

CP_WITH_LOG_TIME.description: Add timestamps to log lines. Any non-empty value enables it, including 0 and false.

CP_QUIET.description: Suppress log output and the startup logo. Always enabled when NODE_ENV=test. Any non-empty value enables it, including 0 and false.

VITE_PORT.description: Port of the Vite development server proxied at /vite (default 5173). Used only when the frontend is not built.

EMBED_VITE_PORT.description: Port of the embed Vite development server proxied at /embed_vite (default 5174). Used only when the frontend is not built.

API_RES_VALIDATION_REPORT.description: File to append API response contract violations to. Used only when NODE_ENV is test or development.

CHERRYPICK_WEBFINGER_USE_HTTP.description: Query WebFinger over HTTP instead of HTTPS for user@host lookups (case-insensitive true). Not limited by NODE_ENV.

FORCE_FOLLOW_REMOTE_USER_FOR_TESTING.description: Follow remote users without a follow request (lowercase true only). Not limited by NODE_ENV.

MISSKEY_TEST_CHECK_DUPLICATED_TOTP.description: Verify TOTP codes and their reuse even when NODE_ENV=test. Only 1 enables it.

CHERRYPICK_TEST_CHECK_IP_RANGE.description: Check the IP range of OAuth client metadata hosts even when NODE_ENV=test. Only 1 enables it.

environment.description: Environment variables read by the backend. Unknown CP_* and CHERRYPICK_* variables are reported as warnings.
